summary: Stock Lifecycle Check (Part 2D) verification pass. Walked through the full Receive -> Approve -> Raw Material stock creation flow, then Processing (consumes RM, creates FP, records Loss), then Merging (0-loss sanity), then all stock-list filters and Select/Action-button design contract. Every requested behavior verified end-to-end via the real UI against Supabase. No production bugs found. One design discrepancy noted for follow-up (Loss list has NO select checkboxes even though the prompt states it should).

issues: The request spec says 'Final Product and Loss lists should have NO create button, only select checkboxes' — Final Product list correctly has select+select-all checkboxes (verified via data-testid=stocks-final-product-table-select-all), but Loss list has NO checkboxes at all because LossList.jsx is a separate component from StocksList.jsx and never renders a select column. If the intended design is to allow bulk-selecting Loss rows (e.g. for export), LossList.jsx needs the same select column pattern StocksList uses when canReceive=false. If Loss is deliberately read-only-view-only, the spec should be updated. Flagging for main-agent design decision — not blocking.

action_items: Decide whether /stocks/loss should have select checkboxes to match the stated design contract; if yes, port the select-column pattern from StocksList.jsx into LossList.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: LossList.jsx duplicates the StocksList list shell (FilterBar + DataTable + AppLayout + page-size state) instead of reusing StocksList's abstractions — makes design invariants like 'Loss and Final Product both show select checkboxes' silently drift, which is exactly what happened here.

ProcessStockForm's destination product select (for the non-Merging path) has no data-testid on the destination-product-0 combobox — had to select it by 'first combobox without data-testid', which is fragile. Add data-testid=`process-destination-product-${idx}` on the SelectTrigger even in Processing mode (only Merging currently sets it, on the locked read-only div).

Approve mutation invalidates queryKey ['transaction', groupId] but the detail page keys off transaction_code (not group id), so the detail page's status badge does not always re-render immediately after Approve — the test observed Approved status NOT visible on the detail page immediately post-click, though the DB write and downstream stock creation both worked correctly. Consider invalidating ['transaction', transactionCode] as well (or refetching from the caller).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full Stock Lifecycle verified. Verified behaviors: (a) Receive tx -> Pending; Approve -> Approved + Raw Material stock created with exact quantity (33 Kg); (b) StockDetail page loads via [data-testid=stock-detail-batch-reference|quantity|village|created-on] and the origin-transaction link renders (data-testid=stock-detail-origin-transaction); (c) Processing decrements the picked RM batch by exactly the consumed amount (33 -> 13), does NOT delete it, creates a Final Product stock at the destination quantity (15 Kg), and records quantity_lost=source-destination on the Processing tx (5 Kg on /stocks/loss); (d) Merging locks destination product to source (data-testid=process-destination-product-0 renders as read-only div showing source product) and equal source/destination produces 0-loss (Loss list count unchanged); (e) Product filter narrows raw-material 8->5 rows (Royal Jelly), Loss product filter works; (f) Design contract: RM has action button + NO select column; Final Product has select+select-all + NO action button; Loss has NEITHER (design gap flagged).
